correctness.rationale: For finite P and upward-closed valuations, every upset U has each element below some m∈μ(U)=U∩Max(P). If V⊆U is an upset with the same μ, then every upset witness B meeting U meets V via a maximal m, so same-frontier fibre-minimal representatives dominate. Conversely, for any U with μ(U)=M, the test with scope A=U and singleton maximal upset witnesses {m}, m∈M, recognizes precisely whether N contains a V⊆U with μ(V)=M, including k=0 and U=∅. These tests recover the minimal antichain in each fibre; the product of fibre-antichain counts follows by independence of the fibres. Chain, discrete and star counts follow, and sharpness uses the full vs full-minus-whole neighbourhood on discrete n points. This is a local box operation theorem; worldwise taking cores need not preserve persistence. Inspected verify.py exhaustively enumerates small finite posets only.
